definitions.explanation: Having the ability to act, speak, or think without restrictions or constraints.
The state of being free; the power to act without constraint.

examples.english: I think freedom of speech is very important.
examples.notes: {言論|げんろん}の{自由|じゆう} = freedom of speech

notes: {自由|じゆう} functions as both a na-adjective ({自由|じゆう}な) and a noun. As a na-adjective: {自由|じゆう}な (before nouns), {自由|じゆう}に (adverbially, meaning 'freely'). The kanji mean 'self' + 'reason/cause' - acting according to one's own will. Related compounds: {不自由|ふじゆう} (inconvenient, disabled), {自由席|じゆうせき} (unreserved seat).
